## Checklist

- [ ] `tools\check.ps1` (or `tools/check.sh`) passes: formatting, tests,
      clippy and the release build, with zero warnings.
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and a fixed bug has a test that would have
      caught it.
- [ ] The change fits [CONSTITUTION.md](../CONSTITUTION.md). A new tool is a
      plugin in its own folder.
- [ ] Text in the app is short, plain English, and no smaller than 12 px.
- [ ] A changed plugin's README and, if users see the change, the main
      README are updated.
- [ ] For a visible change: a screenshot below, light or dark theme.
